changes.description: Scaled stand-alone bin width, height, and depth proportionally to the total CBM of checked-in items, with bounded dimensions and automatic updates after inventory changes.
Added a dedicated Warehouse 1 floor area for stand-alone bins, with automatic placement of newly created and previously unpositioned bins.
Enabled stand-alone bin relocation in Warehouse 1 with in-place location saving and updated movement collision handling.
Added Warehouse 2's dedicated open-floor 3D layout with standalone-bin creation, relocation, and bin inventory inspection.
Added in-scene receiving creation at the loading entrance, plus bin check-in and pick-order workflows for Warehouse 1 and Warehouse 2.
Added perimeter walls and concrete roof slabs to both 3D warehouse views while preserving walk-through navigation.
Preserved the current 3D scene and player position when moving bins or completing bin check-in and pick-order workflows.
Fixed bug in Receiving Reconciliation Report where duplicate items remaining quantity was not calculated correctly.

title: Packing List Versioning, File Downloads & Enhanced Drawer Search

changes.description: Implemented version control for imported Excel packing lists with physical file storage and version tracking.
Added secure document download API endpoints and UI action buttons to download historical Excel packing list versions.
Enhanced async background Receiving Reconciliation Report generator with added Supplier and Remarks columns.
Added real-time product search filter bars to both Incoming Products and Receiving Offloaded Line Items details drawers.
Added interactive 3D warehouse walk and fly navigation mode.
Added Inventory Aging Report and Pick Order Report generation endpoints.
Added background Report Cleaning Service to auto-delete generated report files older than 7 days.
Re-enabled packing list revision uploads for incoming shipments marked as Received.
Added Edit Receiving feature with multi-item pallet grouping, line item additions, and CBM/Weight overrides.
Added production-ready Receiving Reconciliation Report background generation.
Fixed 3D warehouse occupancy renderer for bin 2.

title: Inbound Control, Short Closing & Draft Recovery

changes.description: Introduced Short Close feature for unfulfilled incoming shipments to permanently record lost balances and purge them from active picklists.[cite: 13]
Enabled partial receiving across multi-batch delivery arrivals under a single incoming shipment record.[cite: 13]
Added Receiving Form draft autosaving, session draft restoration, and exit confirmation prompts.[cite: 13]
Revised packing list import rules to support partial uploads, final re-uploads, and duplicate line entries.[cite: 13]
Repositioned receiving module strictly as Proof of Delivery (POD) / Offload Slip workflows.[cite: 13]
Added 3D Interactive Warehouse Occupancy Report for real-time rack utilization tracking and individual bin item inspection.[cite: 13]
Restricted authentication to Google Single Sign-On (SSO) for authorized @skybest.com.ph company domains.[cite: 13]
Added system-wide Audit Trail with Activity Log Inspector displaying Trace IDs, IP addresses, HTTP status codes, and context parameters.[cite: 13]
Integrated pallet sticker barcode scanning and UTC-to-PST localized timestamp rendering utilities.[cite: 13]

title: Lot Traceability, Discrepancy Tracking & Thermal Printing

changes.description: Built real-time 5-dimension discrepancy detection engine comparing physical arrivals against expected baselines.[cite: 14]
Added deterministic server-side Lot Number Generator (LOT-YYYYMMDD-RCV...) with atomic EF Core two-phase commits.[cite: 14]
Engineered multi-product License Plate Number (LPN) 1-to-many pallet mapping and scanner inspection API.[cite: 14]
Added 4" x 6" thermal label printing pipeline powered by an isolated iframe renderer.[cite: 14]
Launched Incoming Transactions grid with real-time SignalR updates and slide-out details drawer.[cite: 14]
Added atomic transactional CSV import pipeline for bulk client packing list uploads with automatic database rollback.[cite: 14]
Migrated WarehouseService to paginated warehouseV2Get endpoints.[cite: 14]
Automated zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipeline via GitHub Actions, SSH, Bun, and EF Core migrations.[cite: 14]
Initial launch of WMS core platform featuring Angular frontend, responsive dashboard, and mobile inventory check/transfer operations.
